# `liber:smartcard@1`

Generated reference for the `liber:smartcard` package (`smartcard.lsidl`). See [the LSIDL language](../../../LSIDL.md).

LiberSystem smart cards - reader presence, exclusive expiring transactions, and a bounded set of PIV operations over a reader one component was granted.  THREE PARTIES, THREE INTERFACES. An APPLICATION holds a `smartcard` connection minted for ONE reader and a set of operations, and nothing on it can name another reader. PERMISSIONMANAGER holds the private `smartcard-admin` endpoint that mints those connections. A PROVIDER - the USB CCID class module, or the in-guest fixture - serves `smartcard-reader`, and SmartcardService is its one consumer.  NO PIN CROSSES ANY OF THEM. `verify-piv-pin` takes a transaction and a deadline and nothing else; the service builds the secure-verification template and the reader's own keypad collects the PIN. A reader without a usable pinpad answers `trusted-input-unavailable`, and there is no operation through which an application could supply a PIN instead.  THE EXCHANGE IS AN ALLOWLIST, NOT A TUNNEL. The PIV application's canonical SELECT and GET DATA for the Discovery Object and the PIV Authentication certificate, and nothing else; authentication is the typed `authenticate-piv`, whose command the service builds.

### record `card-event`

One frame of a reader's event stream: a snapshot, then ordered changes. A removal and a reinsertion are two frames, never one unchanged presence. At most sixteen wait for a client; past that the stream is CLOSED, and a new subscription takes a new snapshot.

## Interfaces

### interface `smartcard`

THE APPLICATION'S CONNECTION, bound to one reader and one set of operations when it was minted.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `reader` | `reader() -> result<reader-info, error>` |  |
| 2 | `slots` | `slots() -> result<list<slot-state>, error>` |  |
| 3 | `events` | `events() -> result<stream<card-event>, error>` |  |
| 4 | `acquire` | `acquire(slot: u8, wait-ms: u32, lease-ms: u32) -> result<transaction, error>` | Wait up to `wait-ms` for the slot, in first-come order behind at most eight others. `lease-ms` is capped at sixty seconds and cannot be renewed. |
| 5 | `exchange` | `exchange(transaction: u64, apdu: list<u8>) -> result<exchange-result, error>` |  |
| 6 | `verify-piv-pin` | `verify-piv-pin(transaction: u64, timeout-ms: u32) -> result<pin-outcome, error>` |  |
| 7 | `authenticate-piv` | `authenticate-piv(transaction: u64, challenge: list<u8>) -> result<authenticate-result, error>` | Sign a 32-byte challenge with the PIV Authentication key (P-256), after a successful verification in this same transaction. |
| 8 | `cancel` | `cancel(transaction: u64) -> result<unit, error>` |  |
| 9 | `release` | `release(transaction: u64) -> result<unit, error>` |  |

### interface `smartcard-admin`

THE MINTING ENDPOINT, PermissionManager's alone. The alias names a reader the service's configuration binds to provider metadata; it resolves to exactly one current publication or the mint fails. The connection lives as long as `owner` does, and no longer, however it is copied.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `mint` | `mint(alias: string, operations: operations, owner: handle<task>) -> result<minted, error>` |  |

### interface `smartcard-reader`

THE PROVIDER CONTRACT a `smartcard-reader` publication serves - to SmartcardService alone. The provider owns the transport: descriptor and slot parsing, ATR, negotiation, sequence numbers, framing, abort and drain. It makes no decision about who may do what.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `describe` | `describe() -> result<reader-description, error>` |  |
| 2 | `open-session` | `open-session() -> result<list<slot-report>, error>` | A NEW SERVICE SESSION. Answered only once everything a previous session left outstanding has been aborted and drained and every slot is powered off. |
| 3 | `events` | `events() -> stream<reader-event>` |  |
| 4 | `power` | `power(header: request-header, on: bool) -> result<provider-reply, error>` |  |
| 5 | `select-protocol` | `select-protocol(header: request-header, protocol: card-protocol) -> result<provider-reply, error>` |  |
| 6 | `exchange` | `exchange(header: request-header, apdu: list<u8>) -> result<provider-reply, error>` |  |
| 7 | `secure-verify` | `secure-verify(request: secure-verify-request) -> result<provider-reply, error>` |  |
| 8 | `abort` | `abort(header: request-header) -> result<provider-reply, error>` | Abort whatever the slot is doing and answer once it is quiescent. |
